Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: Zinātnes noslēpumi
programme.desc: Dažādas mūsu ikdienā ierastas darbības un notikumi, izskaidroti no zinātnes viedokļa.

programme.title: Vienmēr formā!
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Jaunatnes olimpiskās spēles Dakarā
programme.desc: Senegālā turpinās IV Pasaules Jaunatnes olimpiskās spēles, un katru dienu apskatos runāsim par visiem svarīgākajiem dienas notikumiem. Latviju kopumā šajā forumā pārstāv 18 sportisti, kas sacenšas 12 dažādos sporta veidos un disciplīnās. No labāk pazīstamiem veidiem Latvija piedalās 3x3 basketbolā, boksā, peldēšanā, šosejas riteņbraukšanā un vieglatlētikā. Spēlēs ir iekļauti arī tādi veidi, kuru nav klasiskajās olimpiskajās spēlēs, bet kuri ir gana populāri jaunatnes vidū. Šāds sarīkojums notiek jau ceturto reizi, bet pirmoreiz Āfrikas kontinentā. Talantīgākajiem jauniešiem tas ir kā labs atspēriena punkts, lai apliecinātu savu meistarību vienaudžu vidū un pamazām ieietu pieaugušo profesionālajā sportā. Dienas apskatos lielākā vērība būs pievērsta tiem sporta veidiem, kur startē Latvijas dalībnieki, tāpat runāsim par kopumā populārākajiem veidiem.

programme.title: Nozagtā bērna stāsts
programme.desc: Dokumentālās filmas noslēgumā Delimara atgriežas savā bērnības mājā, lai stātos pretī pagātnes rēgiem un sliktajām atmiņām. Kamēr Holivuda uzņem filmu par laimīgām beigām, realitātē ģimeni šķeļ aizdomas par nodevību tuvinieku lokā. Uzziniet, kurš palīdzēja nolaupītājai un kādu cenu par to samaksāja nevainīgs bērns.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Sentmēri gatavojas tradicionālajiem svētkiem, kuru galvenā persona ir festivāla karaliene Tiana Pālmere. Saskaņā ar tradīciju viņai jādodas jūrā ar laivu, lai ziedotu okeānam maizi, rumu un ziedus apmaiņā pret bagātīgu zivju lomu. Taču svētku prieku nomaina šausmas - kad Tianas laiva tuvojas krastam, viņa tajā tiek atrasta mirusi ar dūriena brūci krūtīs. Inspektoram Džekam Mūnijam un viņa komandai jānoskaidro, kurš un kāpēc nogalinājis jauno sievieti, turklāt nozieguma vietā trūkst arī tradicionālā ziedojuma maizes klaipa.

programme.title: Dzīve savvaļā kopā ar Benu Fouglu
programme.desc: Britu dēkainis Bens Fougls šajā dokumentālo filmu ciklā dodas ceļā, lai iepazītos ar cilvēkiem, kas pagriezuši muguru drudžainajam dzīves ritmam un sabiedrībai un nolēmuši vadīt noslēgtu dzīvi neparastās vietās savvaļā saskaņā ar dabu un bez komunālajiem pakalpojumiem. Ceļojums Benu aizvedīs gan uz dažādām interesantām vietām Lielbritānijā, gan uz Islandi. Bens vienu nedēļu mēģinās iejusties viņu dzīvē un piedalīties viņu nodarbēs, katru reizi atklājot un iemācoties kaut ko jaunu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Bruno uzzina par Nansijas krāpšanos ar grūtniecību. Floransa izjautā Akselu - puisi, kurš it kā uzbruka skolotājai Žasminai. Viņš visu noliedz, komanda sāk meklēt pierādījumus viņa alibi. Kad Aksels tiek arestēts par uzbrukumu, viņa tēvs zaudē savaldīšanos.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Melnais saraksts
programme.desc: Kritiķu un skatītāju iemīļots kriminālseriāls. Tā darbība sākas dienā, kad darbu FIB galvenajā birojā Vašingtonā uzsāk jauna profilētāja Elizabete Kīna. Tajā pašā rītā tur ierodas viens no FIB meklētākajiem noziedzniekiem, Reimonds "Reds" Redingtons, un labprātīgi ļauj sevi notvert. Reds palīdz FIB sagūstīt citu bīstamu noziedznieku un novērst uzbrukumu civiliedzīvotājiem. Viņš paziņo, ka viņam esot vesels saraksts un informācija par tādiem noziedzniekiem un teroristiem, par kuru esamību FIB pat nenojauš. Reds ir gatavs sadarboties ar vienu savādu noteikumu – viņš runās tikai ar Elizabeti. Tā sākas īpašas attiecības, kuru īstā daba un iemesls ir zināmi tikai Redingtonam. Lai gan pamatā seriāla darbība norit ASV, tas aizved arī uz dažādām eksotiskām vietām visā pasaulē un ļauj ieskatīties kriminālajā pasaulē. Dažādiem apbalvojumiem vairāku gadu laikā izvirzīti seriāla specefektu veidotāji, kaskadieri un muzikālais noformējums.

programme.title: Markoviča metode
programme.desc: Inženieris Štālverks 1979. gadā atzīstas slepkavībā, kas notikusi sadistisku tieksmju ietekmē. Markovičs un Vilīmeks bažījas, ka viņa advokāts izvēlējies nepareizu aizstāvības taktiku. Eva uztraucas, ka Hojera lietas izmeklēšana Markoviču pārāk ietekmē. Markovičs vēlreiz dodas uz Ūsti, lai neoficiāli lūgtu palīdzību Karelam. Houlīks atklāj, ka viņš nav pakļāvies pavēlei un turpina izmeklēšanu, un šoreiz to kategoriski aizliedz. 1984. gadā notiek Hojera tiesas prāva.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Lapmežciems atrodas piecu ciemu centrā: starp zvejnieku Bigauņciemu un Ragaciemu, kā arī diviem "zemnieku" ciemiem Antiņciemu un Čaukciemu pie Kaņiera ezera. Daudzas ēkas Lapmeža (tā mēdz saukt šo vietu!) centrā uzceltas zvejnieku kolhoza "Selga" darbības laikā. Arī kultūras nams, kurā savijušās 1950. gadu padomju klasicisma arhitektūras un Atmodas laika vērtības, bet daudzu vietējo atmiņā vēl skan Andreja Lihtenberga balss ansambļa "Selga" koncertos. Senajā zvejnieku sētā "Gaiķos" mājvietu radusi biedrība "Jūrciemi", kura ceļ godā vērtības, kas svarīgas pašiem cieminiekiem. Arī zvejniekciemiem raksturīgos apvidvārdus un zivju kūpināšanu.

programme.title: Revidents
programme.desc: Raidījuma komanda revidē un risina dažādus sadzīviskus, praktiskus un ikdienā noderīgus jautājumus. Raidījuma vadītāja Ieva Strazdiņa ne tikai sarunājas ar raidījumā atainoto nozaru speciālistiem un sabiedrības pārstāvjiem, bet arī ļaujas dažādiem eksperimentiem, lai pārliecinātos par to, kā saņemtos padomus pavisam vienkāršā veidā realizēt dzīvē.

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: De facto
programme.desc: LTV Ziņu dienesta veidotajā analītiski pētnieciskajā raidījumā "De Facto" skatītājiem nozīmīgus jautājumus izmeklē žurnālisti Matīss Arnicāns, Inga Šņore, Laine Fedotova, Ivo Leitāns un Ella Semjonova. "De Facto" uzmanības lokā ir netaisnības un pretrunas – ne tikai korupcijas, interešu konfliktu un citu noziedzīgu nodarījumu lietas, bet arī sabiedrībai būtisku cieņpilnas attieksmes un ētiskas rīcības pārkāpumu izmeklēšana.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Theyre falling out of the skies, clogging up rivers and spoiling shorelines around the planet. Why are we seeing mass animal die-offs around the world? Scientists are searching for answers, while also studying why some species are beginning to vanish. In the United States, shrinking populations of bees and bats worry researchers. Are these die-offs natural occurrences, signs of a planet in distress, or are they beyond explanation?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Different cultures call it different things: Bigfoot, Sasquatch, Abominable Snowman and Yeti, but theyre all talking about the same phenomenon and the descriptions are similar: large, hair-covered creatures that walk upright like humans; creatures that live out of sight across the world. Eyewitness accounts stretch back in time, but for many, the Sasquatch is the poster child of the Paranatural, a figment of fevered imaginations, a mere shadow in the woods. But those who say theyve come face to face with this elusive being have no doubt about its existence.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: From Loch Ness to the west coast of Canada, people are reporting sightings of sea creatures they can't explain. Witnesses swear they've spotted creatures with flippers, long necks and horselike heads. Are they seeing remnants from the dinosaurs or mythical beings or just mistaking ordinary creatures for something Paranatural?

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: In an airport where time is money, a routine tail-fin repair on a $208 million dollar A330 jet hangs in the balance; two trainee Airside Operations Controllers have to guide multi-million dollar aircraft precisely to their parking stands; and with the airport near full capacity handling 57 million passengers a year, the new $3.2 billion concourse is trialed to test if it's on schedule to receive 15 million new passengers and 33 of the world's biggest passenger jets - the mighty $389 million dollar Airbus A380.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: With over a million people passing through Dubai International Airport each week, keeping passengers on the move is an increasingly difficult challenge for airport staff. Ultimate Airport follows engineers narrowly averting a crisis in the 55 mile (90 km) baggage system; rookie cabin crew find out if they have what it takes to fly, and the construction team behind the new concourse feel the heat as more than 200 volunteers test whether it's ready to be used by the public.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: During the night-time rush hour, Air Traffic Controller George Perkins gets the call all controllers dread: a plane needs to make an emergency landing at Dubai after an engine shutdown. He has to clear the runway and scramble the emergency services for a landing that could shutter the airport. Airport Services Manager Mel Sabharwal is called in to find out why a transit passenger has live snakes in her bag. In preparation for an ambitious programme of runway repairs, Jumah Al-Mazrooie inspects the overspill airport and finds dangerous debris, storm drains full of sand, and a CCTV system that isn't working. Customs Officers detain a suspicious passenger and find 14kg of heroin secreted in the lining of his suitcase. And Carl Perkins has to avoid damaging expensive cars while loading them into a plane's cargo hold.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Do you sometimes hear a little voice in your head, an inner critic that keeps you from performing at your best? What if we told you there's a way to change what that voice is telling you that will improve your performance in just about anything you try? It might come as a surprise, but research shows thinking positive is more than just a warm and fuzzy idea. And in this episode about positive thinking, we're going to show you how thinking positive can change your thoughts, your reality, and even your life! We're going to mess with your mood to show you what really makes that glass seem half empty or half full; why people who stand tall, stand happy; and how to turn that frown upside down. So get ready to stop worrying and be happy, on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think your field of vision is really in focus, or that your brain is focusing on everything happening in front of you? Think you know exactly what is most important at any given moment? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your focus and attention to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that reveal how your neural hard-wiring can affect what your brain chooses to focus on right now!

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Pay close attention - what you discover in this episode of Brain Games will keep you from falling for a scam. In a robbery, the victim is forced to give up money or possessions. In a scam or con, the victim hands over their valuables willingly. Each year, millions of people around the world fall for some sort of scam or fraud. Through a series of interactive games and experiments, you'll discover how easily your brain is deceived. Scammers and con artists make it their business to know how your brain works, and how to use its flaws to their advantage. Play along to discover how your brain is wired to initially believe everything it hears, what it finds most tempting in an ad or sales pitch, and how simply being human can lead you into some sticky situations. Get ready to fall hook, line, and sinker…on BRAIN GAMES.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: On a remote, fog shrouded island in the freezing waters of Southeast Alaska, a small band of extraordinary people struggle together to subsist off land and sea. Sam undertakes the task of waterproofing his boots. Hans and Timbi have big plans to carve a farm out of the forest, but because of their recent injuries they have to rely on others in the community for help. An extremely low tide exposes portions of the coastline, allowing Gary to forage for sustenance.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The residents of Port Protection deal with the forces of nature, yet again. Curly Leach decides to support the community when he takes on pesky beavers. Sam Carlson finds it's time to start his garden and encounters bad soil so he has to search the surrounding area for the necessary ingredients to sweeten it up. With Hans and Timbi, rough weather and high winds complicate Timbi's situation when she suspects she has a life threatening blood clot and can't leave the island. Meanwhile, Gary Muehlberger sets out to do some King Salmon fishing and encounters another competitor of the sea, which jeopardizes his attempts to catch a fish.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Travelers are reunited with lost treasures, including an expensive pair of vintage Air Jordans, sweaty boxing gear, and a beloved stuffed animal. In Tampa, the K9 unit is called in to ensure an abandoned bag does not contain explosives, and in Norfolk, the airport's auction of lost items, including a van converted into a mobile barber shop, raises nearly $55,000.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: A lone diamond from grandma's ring is lost at Pittsburgh's airport by a young bride. Lost-and-found workers at Tampa International desperately try to find the owner of a fanny pack as it contains much-needed medication and $3,000 in cash. Travelers to a comic convention in Salt Lake City leave behind peculiar objects, including unique fan art acquired at the site.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: Every year, thousands of train crashes and devastating plane disasters occur worldwide. From hijackings to technological failures, these incidents highlight the inherent dangers of travel. Despite daily advancements, a single mistake can lead to catastrophic outcomes. Join us as we explore the 10 most significant air crashes and train accidents, uncovering the tragic events that capture global attention and impact countless lives.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Seoul, South Korea, workers uncover a massive underground chamber hidden beneath the CitiStar Mall and the subway's Line 2. Experts debate its purpose. Was it a Cold War-era bunker, a secret intelligence facility, or simply a byproduct of subway construction? In Poland, excavations beneath a former ice cream shop reveal a medieval tomb marked by a knight carved in limestone. His identity remains unknown, but his burial illuminates the city's turbulent past under shifting dynasties and foreign rule. In England, demolition of the long-lost St. Mary's Church exposes Roman ruins below — three decapitated stone busts and a glass vessel buried in ritual fashion. Finally, in Los Angeles, scientists reexamine the Lincoln Heights whale, a 10-million-year-old fossil from a previously unknown species.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Denmark, metro construction workers uncover a mysterious 19th-century wood-lined tunnel. The undocumented passage may have had possible links to political unrest, private protection or smuggling. In Virginia, excavations beneath a college dormitory reveal the foundation of an 18th-century building and a hidden cellar filled with artifacts from colonial life. Evidence points to the site of one of the earliest schools for enslaved and free Black children in North America. In Finland, a landowner's discovery of a buried sword leads to the excavation of a warrior cemetery dating to the 11th and 12th centuries. Finally, beneath Fonmon Castle in Wales, archaeologists uncover a 6th- or 7th-century cemetery of mostly women whose foreign artifacts, diet and burial customs reveal a society balancing wealth, faith and survival.

programme.title: Dark Secrets of the Sun
programme.desc: It contains 99.9 percent of all the matter in our solar system and sheds hot plasma at nearly a million miles an hour. The temperature at its core is a staggering 27 million degrees Fahrenheit. It convulses, it blazes, it sings. You know it as the sun. Scientists know it as one of the most amazing physics laboratories in the universe. Now, with the help of new spacecraft and Earth-based telescopes, scientists are seeing the sun as they never have before and even recreating what happens at its very center in labs here on Earth. Their work will help us understand aspects of the sun that have puzzled scientists for decades. But more critically, it may help us predict and track solar storms that have the power to zap our power grid, shut down telecommunications, and ground global air travel for days, weeks, or even longer. Such storms have happened before-but never in the modern era of satellite communication. "Dark Secrets of the Sun" reveals a bright new dawn in our understanding of our nearest star-one that might help keep our planet from going dark.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A loud vibration and the smell of smoke warn the pilots of British Midland Flight 92 that they have an engine fire on board. The crew shuts down the engine and tries to land at a nearby airport, but their second engine fails before they can get safely on the ground. Just meters from the runway, the 737-400 slams into an embankment beside Britain's busy M1 motorway. It seems like a rare case of dual engine failure, but investigators soon learn that a tragic misunderstanding may be the real cause of the crash.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: In this episode, archaeologists unlock the mysteries of Egypt's most famous pharaoh, Tutankhamun. We unearth a long lost box of treasures from inside Tutankhamun's tomb. New technology reveals why this boy kings resting place remained hidden from tomb robbers for thousands of years and we join the team who are tasked with transporting Tutankhamun's priceless treasures, on a one in a lifetime journey through the desert. Whilst a team of archaeologists make a new discovery of a lifetime when they open a 4000-year-old tomb.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Why did the great pharaohs of Egypt abandon the pyramids of Giza and choose a secret cemetery in the Valley of the kings as their burial ground? In the shadow of the pyramids, an extraordinary discovery in a rare 4,5000 tomb. We descend 100 meters underground to investigate the first tomb ever built in the valley, whilst a team from the University of Basel are on the hunt for clues to identify human remains found in looted tombs.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: For millions, Jesus is both the Son of God and an actual historical figure. But what archaeological evidence exists about the people and places that shaped his life? The investigation begins at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem, said to be built upon Jesus' burial place. But there's a puzzle: In the 1st century AD, burials only took place outside the city walls, yet the church sits firmly within the Old City. Can experts solve the mystery? Elsewhere in Jerusalem, archaeologists hunt for the site where Jesus is said to have performed the miraculous healing of a Blind man — the Siloam Pool — and look for clues about the events of his final days, including the Last Supper. Beyond Jerusalem, investigators hunt for the lost town of Bethsaida, site of the feeding of five thousand and home to three of his disciples.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Israel, archaeologists investigate the truth behind one of the greatest discoveries in history: the Dead Sea Scrolls. Found in 1947 deep in the Judean desert, this remarkable haul of 2,000-year-old manuscripts includes the oldest copies of the biblical texts ever found. But no one knows who wrote them or why they were hidden. In this episode, investigators combine traditional excavations with revolutionary analytical technologies to uncover new evidence that could help solve these mysteries. Cutting-edge imaging techniques reveal hidden clues in the scrolls — which could help identify the authors — while archaeological discoveries in Jerusalem paint a picture of a brutal, destructive event that would tear apart the ancient Jewish world around the time the scrolls were hidden.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Teams of archaeologists uncover evidence that sheds light on one of the most terrifying stories in history: the legend of King Minos and the fearsome Minotaur. Can new discoveries reveal what inspired these terrifying legends? Who were the mysterious Minoans, the society that gave rise to this myth?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: The Parthenon is one of the most iconic buildings in history. Today, a team of architects and engineers works to ensure its long-term survival. How was the Parthenon built, and what does it tell us about the rise of Athens in ancient Greece? As archaeologists across the Mediterranean unearth fragments of the past, they piece together the secrets of this remarkable civilization.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In the halls of Queen Elizabeth I's court, John Dee was both lauded as a brilliant mathematician and feared as a summoner of angels and demons. In his pursuit to learn the secrets of the universe, he plunged deeper into occult — and awkward territory. In the waters of Japan, a terrifying fish-creature with humanlike features washed ashore, sparking fear and anxiety. For centuries, it was seen as an omen of death, as horrific events seemed to follow in the wake of each Ningyo discovery. But with time, the Ningyo's meaning morphed. In ancient Egypt, a controversial pharaoh sought the aid of the gods. Entering the smoky temple of the oracle of Amun, she desperately hoped to receive the divine guidance needed to maintain her grasp on power.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 17th-century Sicily, a devoted nun believed she was channeling a dark spirit when she penned a cryptic letter in garbled language. For centuries, the Church guarded the secrets of the damned dispatch, unable to crack its code. In 2017, the startling message was finally deciphered. In ancient Greece, a cult dedicated to the god of healing promised cures and prophetic visions. Pilgrims traveled from far and wide for miraculous medical interventions — and strange visions during sleep. And in Ireland, as warriors like the legendary Cúchulainn prepared for battle, they were believed to be visited by the Morrigan — an archaic goddess of war and fate, whose shape-shifting presence was seen as a sign of glorious victory or disastrous defeat.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Dutch Caribbean Coastguards
programme.desc: We went on a mission with the Coast Guard of Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and Sint Maarten. Every day they carry out impressive operations, from rescuing tourists in distress to intercepting drug shipments at sea and receiving undocumented immigrants. This important and also dangerous work is done by a team of committed professionals, who guarantee safety in the Caribbean Sea with the help of ships and helicopters. They are supported by the Royal Netherlands Navy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Welcome to Brain Games – and London. Host Jason Silva takes you to sites around London, from ancient to modern, to show how they correlate to the different areas of our brains. Over tens of thousands of years, we have evolved from a more primitive way of survival to where we are today. What really goes on inside our brains - why and how do we react to things automatically, adapt to the world around us, and solve problems? Ultimately, all these regions together could really be the key to understanding how the brain works to create the human mind.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Pay close attention - what you discover in this episode of Brain Games will keep you from falling for a scam. In a robbery, the victim is forced to give up money or possessions. In a scam or con, the victim hands over their valuables willingly. Each year, millions of people around the world fall for some sort of scam or fraud. Through a series of interactive games and experiments, you'll discover how easily your brain is deceived. Scammers and con artists make it their business to know how your brain works, and how to use its flaws to their advantage. Play along to discover how your brain is wired to initially believe everything it hears, what it finds most tempting in an ad or sales pitch, and how simply being human can lead you into some sticky situations. Get ready to fall hook, line, and sinker…on BRAIN GAMES.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Our experts examine the brain's internal tug of war between fear and rationalization. Whether boarding an airplane or walking down a spooky street at night, we'll see how dread and anticipation build feelings of fear. Putting our host's emotions to the test, Apollo Robbins challenges Jason Silva to a game of Russian roulette. Then, with the help of John Harlacher, co-director of one of New York City's scariest haunted houses, we "Fear Factor" a group of volunteers. Without their senses of sight, sound, or control of their limbs, see how they react to snakes, cockroaches and rats... or so they think.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: The average adult spends more than 220,000 hours - or roughly 25 years - in bed sleeping. That's one third of your life spent in slumber! But what exactly is sleep? Why do you spend so much of your time doing it? And what happens to your brain and body if you don't get a full night's rest? In what could be our most ambitious Brain Games experiment ever, we keep 3 volunteers awake for 36 hours in order to test the effects of sleep deprivation on human performance. Join them in our special Sleep Lab, and play along as we put them through a battery of physical and mental tests. Will their scores hold up, or will the lack of "Z's" cause them to crash? Who will make it through the sleepless marathon - the young math tutor Taylor, our burly plumber John, or Melissa, an entrepreneur and mother of four? You're going to want to stay up for this special episode… of Brain Games.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Winter's end is approaching and the change of season brings new opportunities, while closing the door on others. Sam has heard from other fishermen that halibut have been caught in the area. After months of living off of frozen food he's eager to catch some of the savory fish. Meanwhile trapping season is coming to a close and that means Gary is losing one of his main sources of income. He sets out for one last trapping trip in an effort to get enough fur to help meet his expenses for the year. Curly gets word that a massive tree is threatening a local house, and Mary sets out on the inexhaustible hunt for firewood.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Spring has come to Port Protection and with it a host of chores and opportunities. Mary Miller takes advantage of bear season and heads into the nearby woods to hunt her first black bear. Gary Muehlberger sets out to trap a beaver in the hopes of teaching Port Protection's newest resident, Amanda Makar, how to skin and treat it for its fur. And Hans and Timbi Porter overcome their recent surgeries and hike up a nearby mountain for firewood to an astonishing patch of land known as "the blow down."

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on the restoration of a lightweight British pocket rocket , a 1997 Lotus Elise. The car's owner, 44 year old former print manager Sarah, had been planning to get the car back on the road with the help of her dad Phil until double tragedy struck - he fell victim to incurable bowel cancer then sadly Sarah herself was also diagnosed with cancer. The car's restoration was put on hold. Mother Jenny wrote in to Car SOS hoping to bring back her daughter's much needed smile.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have travelled to Milton Keynes to try and rescue Craig's 1930 Ford Model A, an historic car with an impressive pedigree. The car's owner is 58 year old former electrician Craig a dyed in the wool classic car lover. He's had his Model A for over 30 years, however after a tragic motor cycle accident any plans for restoration evaporated when his whole world was turned upside down. Once the car hits the Car SOS workshop its wooden coachwork and 90 year old parts prove a big challenge for the team.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on a 1972 Peugeot 504 cabriolet - a rare French grand tourer that is considered by many to be the most beautifully designed car that Peugeot ever produced. The car belongs to former NHS dentist Barry who bought it back in the 1980s . He had planned to restore his much loved motor back to its former glory but when family issues and ill health got in the way his Peugeot dream came to an end. His family put in a call to Car SOS hoping that Tim and Fuzz could help say a big thank you to this pillar of the local community.

programme.title: Lost Cities with Albert Lin
programme.desc: Lost Cities combines hi-tech archaeology, breath-taking visuals and genuine exploration to make headline-grabbing discoveries. Lost Cities brings adventure, science and archaeology together through our host Albert Lin. Our ambitious approach applies 3D scanning to some of the most extraordinary sites of antiquity. This series will deliver powerful, emotional stories with hi-tech imagery to bring the mysteries of the past vividly to life.

programme.title: Lost Cities with Albert Lin
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Albert Lin travels to the mountains of Peru to discover the origins of its most famous site, Machu Picchu. Using LiDAR technology Albert finds proof of the people who came before the Inca, and treks high into the mountains to find their homes and ceremonial sites. Gathering the evidence, Albert reveals that the Inca city may have been inspired by another, even older civilisation.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers reunite travelers with their missing items, including a sentimental 40th-anniversary gift and a wallet brimming with $1,500 in cash. A man breaks into a song of gratitude when his two laptops are returned to him. Agents in Denver discover a bag packed with rotting fish and put on their detective hats to hunt for the owner of a jewelry box full of treasures.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport Lost and Found workers reunite travelers with a dog who wiggled out of his leash upon arrival and wandered the airport grounds for a week, a collection of vintage tennis rackets belonging to a pro tennis player, a purse containing over a hundred dollars in cash, a backpack brimming with lifesaving prescription medicine, a child's beloved stuffed panda bear, and a full Army uniform.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: November 27, 1987. A 747 Combi is on a routine flight toward South Africa when the cabin begins filling with smoke. Passengers struggle to breathe as crew members attempt to fight a fire in the cargo hold. After the plane disappears in the Indian Ocean, an unprecedented recovery operation is launched to locate and raise the wreckage from the ocean floor. Rumours swirl. Did illegal weapons bring down Flight 295?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A small commuter plane begins a short flight when disaster strikes. Moments after takeoff, the nose of the aircraft pitches up dramatically. The flight crew struggles for control. The plane is just 350 meters in the air when it stalls, rolls to the left, and plummets to the ground. It slams into a packed hangar, killing everyone on board. Combing through the wreckage, investigators find a single clue that leads them to uncover a string of errors and faulty assumptions that have been putting millions of passengers at risk for years.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: April 4, 1977. Southern Airways flight 242 is en-route from Huntsville, Alabama to Atlanta, Georgia. Ten minutes into the flight the crew notices a menacing storm in their path. Their radar shows them a "hole" in the middle of the storm, the crew believes that "hole" is an area of better weather, and decides to fly towards it. Suddenly the plane is in the midst of a punishing rain and hailstorm. The hail is so severe that it cracks the cockpit windshield, and visibility is nonexistent. They crew has lost power to many of their instruments, and one by one theyve lost both of their engines. Theyre now trying to glide to a safe landing. The tower suggests heading towards Dobbins Air Force Base, 20 miles away. En route to Dobbins the crew realizes they arent going to make it, they decide to put the DC-9 down on a nearby highway. Almost immediately though, it clips a tree with its left wing, ploughs into a car at service station, breaks up and bursts into flames. An inferno erupts. The flight crew, 62 passengers, and 8 people on the ground are killed. Astoundingly, 21 people on board survive.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: We follow archaeologists hunting for Queen Cleopatra's lost tomb. A team of underwater archaeologists dive the Mediterranean to explore the sunken ruins of ancient Alexandria. Another team take a batch of 4000-year old mummies to the hospital to scan for hidden treasure. And a lawyer-turned-archaeologist discovers a secret tunnel network at a forgotten temple that could lead her to the jackpot - the tomb of the last Pharaoh of Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Along the Western edge of the Valley of the Kings, lies one of the last tombs left to be excavated in modern times. This season, American Egyptologist Don Ryan is working against the clock to conduct a forensic examination of the contents of Tomb 49, hoping to find treasures left behind by ancient tomb robbers. His team makes a dramatic discovery - the 3,000-year-old ring of Ramses III, one of Egypt's greatest pharaohs - a find that changes the course of Don's investigations and lifts the lid on the astonishing story of ancient state-sanctioned tomb robbery on an industrial scale. Nearby in Deir el Bahari, Archaeologist Antonio Morales and his team are investigating how ancient tomb builders cleverly designed their tombs to try to evade would-be thieves. Outside the tomb of the nobleman Ipi, the team unearth a hidden underground chamber. They also investigate their rare find of 56 mummification jars, intact with Ipi's remains - including a mummified human heart. What was left behind by robbers and previous explorers proves to be the greatest treasure of all today, as it throws precious light on the mysteries of ancient mummification rituals. The battle against tomb robbers continues today. In Cairo, Dr Shabaan of the Ministry of Antiquities is working with US Homeland Security on the case of three ancient mummy parts for sale on the black market in New York. Can Dr Shabaan successfully repatriate the remains to their rightful home in Egypt?

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The biggest cocaine busts from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A man traveling to the DR, hides cocaine in children's organizers. A stepmom and daughter conceal bricks of cocaine inside jackets. A mother with a child carries cocaine in food packages and kid's clothes. The Anti-narcotics police find cocaine in a shipment of fresh herbs. A man going to Mexico with cocaine bricks in his carry-on. A man with liquid cocaine in beverage bottles.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Stories of suspects who almost got away from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A farmer swaps his suitcase with an accomplice in the terminal. A man who ingested cocaine is able to board a plane, but through international police coordination, is apprehended at his destination. A man with capsules in his stomach holds out for 36 hours and must be released. His sister is arrested. Cocaine cargo has been chemically disguised to fool officials.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: As part of a joint effort during Super Bowl LIV, dubbed "Operation Team Player," CBP and HSI seize more than 176,000 counterfeit items, and make multiple arrests related to human trafficking and drug smuggling. HSI Atlanta conducts a controlled delivery of a hollowed-out truck battery filled with 5 kilos of heroin. And HSI New York tracks a suspected drug courier, a.k.a. "Busy Bee", who is found to have pellets of cocaine concealed on his person.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Atlanta discovers a suitcase left in the airport by its owner, which contains cocaine concealed in coffee bags. Suspecting a trend, officers begin blitzing flights from the source country and make a second arrest. CBP Miami investigates a series of wildlife trafficking crimes, including an elderly man suspected of smuggling birds to the US in his pants; and a shipment of more than 1400 turtle shell fragments that were forcibly removed from an endangered species. HSI New York arrests a suspected cocaine smuggler who works at JFK and uncovers information that takes-down an entire drug-trafficking ring.

Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: November 27, 1987. A 747 Combi is on a routine flight toward South Africa when the cabin begins filling with smoke. Passengers struggle to breathe as crew members attempt to fight a fire in the cargo hold. After the plane disappears in the Indian Ocean, an unprecedented recovery operation is launched to locate and raise the wreckage from the ocean floor. Rumours swirl. Did illegal weapons bring down Flight 295?

programme.title: Dutch Caribbean Coastguards
programme.desc: We went on a mission with the Coast Guard of Curaçao, Aruba, Bonaire and Sint Maarten. Every day they carry out impressive operations, from rescuing tourists in distress to intercepting drug shipments at sea and receiving undocumented immigrants. This important and also dangerous work is done by a team of committed professionals, who guarantee safety in the Caribbean Sea with the help of ships and helicopters. They are supported by the Royal Netherlands Navy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we arrive in the holy city of Jerusalem to explore what we call the "God Brain." Billions of people around the world believe in a divine being, but how does the "believing brain" work? Is spirituality hardwired or installed in us by a divine Programmer, or is it part of a complex evolutionary adaptation process that has been transpiring for millions of years? This episode is an exciting opportunity to exploit hidden-camera experiments, man-on-the-street encounters, and high-tech laboratories across the globe in the quest to explore the neuro-physiology behind spiritual practice. The games devised in this episode will shed light on our perception of morality, faith, and the supernatural.You will learn that even those who don't practice religion feel an instinctual desire to believe, a desire that Dean Hamer from the National Institute of Heath calls "the God gene." Play along as we engage in brain games that suggest you do believe even if you think you dont!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home
programme.desc: Africa is an extraordinary continent. It is home to the planet's greatest gatherings of wildlife and every imaginable habitat. From deserts and mountain peaks to dense jungle and exotic islands, all life here is shaped by the place it calls home. In this dynamic land, animals must be ready to adapt.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Spanning 50% of the continent, Africa's savannahs are home to an exceptionally diverse array of creatures — including Africa's deadliest. Highly adaptable and remarkably resilient, predators like lions and hyenas must contend with both competitors and equally well-equipped prey species. From highspeed cheetah hunts in the Karoo to deadly river crossings in the Serengeti, Africa's savannah specialists battle it out for survival in these hostile landscapes.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Vital to the survival of many species, waterholes draw large concentrations of animals seeking to quench their thirst. But these wildlife hotspots are anything but peaceful oases — where there is water, Africa's deadliest are often nearby. From Nile crocodiles waiting beneath the surface for their parched prey to come to them to violent territorial disputes between giant hippo bulls, Africa's waterholes set the stage for some of the continent's greatest spectacles.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Southern Africa's Bushveld region is home to the icons of the African continent. It's an untamed wilderness where ancient battles for survival play out on a grand scale. Governed by the turning of the seasons, it's a place of the big hitters of the natural world and eternal enemies must savagely fight for their right to rule using brute strength, speed, agility or cunning to claim their place at the top.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Set sail for Australia's extraordinary islands and meet a fascinating cast of baby animals. Follow green sea turtle hatchlings as they race from sandy nests to the ocean, fur seal pups learning to swim along rugged coastlines, and quokka joeys taking their first hops beside their mothers. In Tasmania, feisty Tasmanian devil joeys emerge from the pouch ready to explore. Far to the south on subantarctic Macquarie Island, fluffy king penguin chicks, elephant seal pups and young albatrosses face the challenges of life in a harsh and windswept world. Packed with amazing animal behaviors, surprising wildlife facts and unforgettable family moments, this episode reveals the remarkable journeys that transform Australia's island babies from vulnerable newborns into confident young adventurers.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines, the giant rodents in Africa; the martial eagle, the biggest of its kind on the continent; and the leopard, a giant among the spotted cats.

programme.desc: From killer whales to moose, there are a lot of ways to die out there. programme.desc: TV series that captures the wildlife that lives within of Africa. A number of iconic species call the vast biodiversity in this country and help us to understand their natural behaviours in their habitats. Jack Spencer takes us on a journey to look at the amazing communities ranging from a pride of fearsome lions, to a herd of enormous elephants to the smaller insects and everything in between. Each episode has a main focus of one animal group or topic within Africa so for those who enjoy learning about Africa, this programme is for you.

programme.title: 20 Animals That Will Kill You
programme.desc: Wild animals kill thousands of people every day - and the most dangerous creatures may not be what you think. From Bengal tigers to elephants to mosquitos, animals can kill in a multitude of ways. Predators are obvious killers, but others defend their territory, attack in self-defense, or kill by sheer accident. Wildlife experts break down some of the most revealing attacks caught on tape to expose what animals kill the most people, how they kill, and why.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixers face one emergency after another. Max the dog arrives dangerously overheated, and the cause is unclear. Sunny the puppy needs surgery after an accident involving a pizza delivery driver. Koda the dog starts shaking, and a trash can may hold a clue. Zoey's bathroom troubles lead to a shocking X-ray for this older canine, while another dog's rattlesnake bite becomes more urgent after her family must call around for antivenom. Charlotte, a badly injured puppy found behind a middle school, receives emergency care and begins a long road to recovery. As cases keep coming in, the team moves fast, finds answers and gives each patient the care they need to get back on their feet.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. Crossbills have hooked beaks to pluck seeds from spruce cones. As for the rare capercaillie, they digest pine needles by eating stones that grind the needles up in their digestive system. Despite the challenging but seasonal weather conditions, winter is mating season for the Carpathian's most elusive inhabitant and rarest animal: the lynx. Almost extinct in the rest of Europe, the vast wilderness of the Carpathians helps the species survive and thrive.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Indochina's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Cambodia is a mystical land, shaped by the monsoon and the mighty Mekong river. An ancient land, once ruled by a great empire, which thrived in walled cities, surrounded by temples and water. It's this water that dominates the country and has created some of the most unique ecosystems on the planet…

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. Crossbills have hooked beaks to pluck seeds from spruce cones. As for the rare capercaillie, they digest pine needles by eating stones that grind the needles up in their digestive system. Despite the challenging but seasonal weather conditions, winter is mating season for the Carpathian's most elusive inhabitant and rarest animal: the lynx. Almost extinct in the rest of Europe, the vast wilderness of the Carpathians helps the species survive and thrive.

programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda ķeras klāt savam lielākajam būvniecības projektam - debesskrāpim. Tik liela darba izpildei ir nepieciešami jauni, milzīgi braucamie. Kad Ātrmeistars ierauga ķepaiņu jaunos braucamos, viņš vēršas pie sava lielā brāļa pēc palīdzības

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora, Zābaciņš un Karte palīdz tēvocim Tesoro atrast pazaudētos dārgumu pēddziņus un atkal kļūt par dārgumu karti. Dora un Zābaciņš pēta noslēpumainu atslēgu, lai iepazītu Doras vecvecvecmāmiņu - pašu pirmo zinātkāro pētnieci.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērniem patīk nakts pasaciņas, bet ne tad, ja tās visu laiku atkārtojas. Barbabella pavada nemierīgu nakti kukaiņu dēļ.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais uzbūvē māju kokā. Barbamamma ir apņēmusies novērst piesārņojumu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala saņem paciņu ar rozā zvēriņiem, ko nosauc par Skvīkijiem. Barbabravo, Barbalala un Barbabo ir apnicis, ka brāļi un māsas par viņiem smejas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Dvīņi ciemojas Barbagudrā istabā. Kādus sapņus sasniegtu, ja es būtu miljardieris?

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls ar komandu pārvācas uz Celtnieklīci, kur viņi dzīvo, spēlējas un būvē visu, kas vien nepieciešams.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un viņa celtnieksuņu ģimene gatavojas būvēt tiltu, taču nelietīgajam Ātrmeistaram ir cita ideja. Rabla komandai jāstrādā kopā un jāizglābj visi, uzbūvējot jaunu, drošu tiltu uz Celtnieklīci.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: "Blū pavedienos tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū un viņas kopējs Džošs aicina skatītājus piedalīties mīklu minēšanas piedzīvojumos. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu šo uzdevumu!

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija apmaldās izklaides centrā. Tims meklē jaunu, sev piemērotu raķeti. Kad Terija pieskata bērnus, Tims cenšas apiet visus noteikumus.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz Riveram uzņemt daudz fotogrāfiju foto konkursam, uzbūvējot ļoti ātru veidu, kā pārvietoties pa Celtnieklīci. Rabls un ķepaiņi palīdz Karlam pagatavot saldējumu visiem. Ja vien Ātrmeistars viņiem netraucēs...

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Zābaciņš grib paaugties lielāks, lai drīkstētu vizināties karuseļos - taču kļūst milzīgs! Dora viņam palīdz atgūt ierasto izmēru. Mugursomai ir īpaša dāvana Dorai, bet tā nevar atvērties! Draugi dodas lūgt palīdzību vecmāmiņai.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Salda un garda diena Blū beķerejā, jo Blū un Džošs cep bibinku, Filipīnās iecienītu kūku. Spēlēsim "Blū pavedieni", lai noskaidrotu, kam Blū vēlas cept, un palīdzētu Banānu cepējai lasīt banānus viņas Pērtiķu mafiniem.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Zobainais, mīlīgais Krokodila kungs kopā ar labāko draudzeni Deiziju bezbēdīgi lavierē pa dzīvi, kas pilna trakiem piedzīvojumiem un komiskiem pārpratumiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Tētis paskaidro Barbabravo un Barbalalai, ka viņi var spēlēties, kā vēlas, bet bērni nesaprot, ka tētis neļāva viņiem kļūt par maziem dumpiniekiem. // Kas ir Barbapapas? Viņi ir dažādās krāsās, spēj transformēties, daži ir spalvaini. Atbildi var atras tikai Barbazinātne.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala rīko lielo talantu konkursu. Katram barbabērnam uz skatuves jādemonstrē savs lielākais talants, nekādas nīkuļošanas! // Videospēles ir jautras, bet jāmāk izbaudīt jauki laikapstākļi. Vecāki izlemj bērniem radīt jautras rotaļas ārā. Bet lomas un mīklas jādala uzmanīgi, lai nerodas pārsteīgumi.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja meklē pludmalē apraktos niekus. Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē. Tims, Tija un Tomijs cenšas pārliecināt mammu un tēti par labu mīlulim.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Reksu ģimene dodas ceļojumā cauri galaktikai, lai nokļūtu Raķešpasaulē. Tims un Kaja cīnās par Terijas rezerves biļeti uz Kosmoslendu. Tims, Tija un Tomijs rīko talantu šovu, bet nevar izlemt, kurš uzstāsies pirmais.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Timam un tētim jānoķer traucējošs kurmis.
